findings.defect_location: Core v2.6 candidate.1 sections 2 and 6.2; Adapter v0.7 candidate.1 sections 8 and 9

exact_evidence.user_requirement: 只有Developer是能改代码的角色，其他的Reviewer, Adjudicator, challenger，以及其他的在develop loop里面的角色都只能只读。
exact_evidence.ambiguous_predecessor_text: 沿用同一 Developer、Reviewer A、Final Fresh Challenger 和 Adjudicator完成修复与 closure
exact_evidence.risk: The predecessor could be misread as authorizing Challenger participation in remediation or leaving unnamed Develop Loop roles without an explicit product-read-only restriction.

findings.root_cause: Write authority was expressed in per-role bullets instead of one exhaustive invariant covering every Develop Loop identity and indirect tool delegation.
findings.minimal_revision: Declare Developer as the sole product-write identity; make all other Develop Loop roles product-read-only; route accepted Challenger code findings through Adjudicator to Developer; treat any indirect non-Developer product mutation as a workflow violation.
